why: After 2.29.1 a protected fix-only 2.x line must exist before master turns into the v3 prerelease line; publish.yml on v2 already carries the tag step from rel-1.
what: Owner or orchestrator row. Branch v2 at the v2.29.1 tag, a fix-only release config and commitlint committed on it, v2 added to the ruleset, CI running on v2. A lead cannot push a new branch or edit a ruleset, and the factory only recognises ships reachable from the default branch, so no lead builds this.
contract: docs/v3/concepts/migration-release.md 4.1 step 3, 4.3, 4.6 and docs/v3/evidence/gap-repo-surface-release-proof.md 2.5 (ruleset). v2 .releaserc.json branches is exactly ["v2"]; commitlint type-enum has no `feat`. Not a dist-tag named v2 (npm refuses it).
exemplar: master's .releaserc.json and commitlint.config.ts as the base to edit.
change: Owner or orchestrator, from a clean clone with admin rights, before v2 is protected: `git fetch origin --tags && git switch -c v2 v2.29.1`; set .releaserc.json `branches` to ["v2"]; delete 'feat' from type-enum in commitlint.config.ts; set ci.yml push branches to [master, v2]; `git commit -am 'ci: fix-only release config for the v2 line' && git push origin v2`. Ruleset: `ID=$(gh api repos/jkrumm/basalt-ui/rulesets --jq '.[]|select(.name=="protect-default-branch").id')` then `gh api repos/jkrumm/basalt-ui/rulesets/$ID | jq '{name,target,enforcement,bypass_actors,conditions,rules} | .conditions.ref_name.include += ["refs/heads/v2"]' | gh api -X PUT repos/jkrumm/basalt-ui/rulesets/$ID --input -`. Lead, on pick-up: raise a factory Decision (`factory issue ask`) with these commands as the recommendation, keep the Issue open and waiting, and close it only after the owner acted and every acceptance line is met (a closed Issue releases rel-4). Verify read-only.
commits: None from a lead. The v2 commit is `ci:` and non-package; the ruleset edit is a gh api call, not a commit.
proof: git and gh reads only; a CI run on the v2 push.
acceptance: gh api repos/jkrumm/basalt-ui/rulesets/<id> --jq '.conditions.ref_name.include' contains refs/heads/v2 (id from the protect-default-branch ruleset).
git show origin/v2:.github/workflows/ci.yml contains v2 in push branches, and gh run list --branch v2 --workflow CI shows a run for the ci: commit.
git diff --name-only v2.29.1 origin/v2 lists only .releaserc.json, commitlint.config.ts and .github/workflows/ci.yml.
out_of_scope: The version gate and its copy onto v2 (rel-4b), any package change, Renovate on v2.
